geopolitics_summary: Middle East tensions escalating; EU Russia sanctions framework agreed after Greece concession on gas; Iran conflict threatens Strait of Hormuz LNG flows.

themes.headline: EU clinches Russia sanctions deal after Greek gas concession
themes.why_it_matters: Resolves sanctions stalemate and freezes crude price cap for 12 months. Clarifies EU policy on Russian gas transit; reduces immediate sanctions uncertainty risk to TTF and EU power via gas cost channel.

themes.headline: Natural gas prices surge amid Middle East violence and Strait instability
themes.why_it_matters: Traders pricing structural Hormuz risk into LNG; direct TTF upside if Asian demand holds and supply disruption persists. EU LNG competition intensifies, raising marginal gas cost and power generation costs.

themes.headline: Mexico's second LNG terminal ships first cargo; adds 0.4 Bcf/d supply
themes.why_it_matters: New LNG capacity eases global supply; reduces marginal LNG costs available to NW Europe, weakening TTF bid. Indirect downside to EU power via lower gas-weighted marginal generation cost.

themes.headline: Trump threatens Iran infrastructure strikes; escalates Strait of Hormuz risk
themes.why_it_matters: Increases probability of Hormuz transit disruption, tightening global LNG supply. EU dependent on spot LNG for marginal gas; escalation raises TTF volatility and peak power risk.

themes.headline: Spain's massive forest fires displace 100,000; emergency response strained
themes.why_it_matters: Severe weather event; potential near-term demand spike from emergency services and AC load, offset by possible grid disruptions. Spanish DA spreads and Iberian power curve to monitor; minor direct impact vs. macro themes.

watchlist: EU Russia sanctions implementation timeline and any further gas transit clarifications.
Iran–US escalation in Strait of Hormuz; monitor for LNG voyage delays, spot LNG premiums.
Mexico Energia Costa Azul Phase 2 development; track capacity ramp and NW Europe delivery schedules.
Spain wildfire recovery impact on nuclear/thermal plant availability and summer load dynamics.
